pages.image_type: annotated color photograph (lunar surface scene with magnified inset)
pages.description: A photograph shows a gray, rocky lunar-like surface stretching to a horizon in the upper third, above which is a dark greenish-black sky. In the foreground the long shadow of a photographer or figure with equipment is cast across the textured, rock-strewn ground. Several small black cross-hair reticle marks are visible across the surface. A yellow rectangular box near the horizon marks a small feature, and lines connect it to a large magnified inset in the upper portion of the image, showing an enlarged pixelated area containing a faint vertical bright blue streak or smudge against the dark background. No legible text is present.

observations.claim: A yellow rectangular outline appears near the horizon line at right of center
A larger yellow-bordered inset in the upper area shows a magnified, pixelated region
The magnified inset contains a faint vertical blue streak
The foreground shows a shadow of a figure cast across rocky ground
Small black cross-shaped reticle marks are distributed across the surface
The sky above the horizon is dark greenish-black
No legible text is present in the image
